site.tagline: Evakuators.am — find a tow truck anywhere in Armenia

nearest.intro: Press the button and allow location access. We'll show you the nearest active tow trucks — with distance and estimated arrival time. Your location is not stored.

nearest.allowanceRemaining: You have {left} of {limit} detailed searches left today — with road distance and travel time. Pressing again within an hour won't use up a new search.
nearest.featureDisabledError: We're working on this feature right now. It will be available soon.
nearest.apiDisabledError: Search isn't available right now. Use the region and city search below instead.
nearest.searchFailedError: Couldn't find nearby tow trucks. Check your connection and try again.
nearest.emptyTitle: No tow trucks found near you
nearest.emptyDescription: There may not be a registered driver in this area yet, or they haven't set their location yet. Try finding a driver by region or city instead.
nearest.resultsTitle: The tow trucks nearest to you
nearest.cachedAtDisclaimer: This list was built at {time}, based on your location at that time.
nearest.distanceDisclaimer: Distance is calculated from the driver's stated home base, not their real-time GPS position. Confirm the exact time with the driver by phone.
nearest.degradedByAllowanceText: Straight-line distance is shown because today's detailed searches have been used up. The list is complete — these are the drivers nearest you, just without road distance and travel time. The actual route is usually longer.
nearest.routingDownText: The road-distance service isn't available right now, so straight-line distance is shown instead. The actual route is usually longer.
nearest.fallbackTitle: Or find one by region and city
nearest.fallbackText: If location access is not available, pick your region or city to see all the tow trucks working there.

about.metaDescription: Evakuators.am is a platform for finding tow trucks in Armenia — find a tow truck working in your area and call the driver directly.
about.title: About us
about.p1: Evakuators.am is a platform that brings together, in one place, tow trucks working in every region of Armenia and every administrative district of Yerevan. Our goal is for anyone with car trouble to find an available tow truck in their area within 1-2 minutes and call the driver directly, with no intermediaries.
about.p2: On the platform you'll see real photos of the vehicles, the types of services offered, and starting prices.
about.p3: If you're a tow truck driver, you can register and start receiving orders from your area.
